principles: Deterministic: all fixture IDs are static and versioned
PostgreSQL as final truth: no mock as final basis for gate-relevant tests
Workspace isolation: dedicated workspace_id per scenario
Teardown mandatory: no persistent state after test completion
not_scope: mocks as final truth for gate-relevant tests
automatic baseline updates from test results

scenarios.name: Korrekte Daten (Baseline / Happy Path)

state.documents: N active documents; is_searchable=true for all chunks

scenarios.purpose: Verifies no False Positives in clean workspace

scenarios.name: Lifecycle Drift

variants.state: lifecycle_status=archived; chunks is_searchable=true; not in index

scenarios.purpose: Verifies LIFECYCLE_DRIFT detection; critical when deleted document is searchable

scenarios.name: Source Status Drift

state.sources: 1 source with source_status=active; connectivity check fails; last_successful_sync beyond configured timeout

scenarios.notes: Connectivity check uses test stub for external network response only; PostgreSQL data_sources is authoritative
scenarios.purpose: Verifies SOURCE_STATUS_DRIFT detection; stub is not a mock for final truth

scenarios.name: Retrieval Drift
scenarios.purpose: Verifies RETRIEVAL_DRIFT detection with threshold-based escalation

scenarios.name: Metadata Drift

state.documents: N documents with import_status=completed; required field 'language' missing on all

scenarios.critical_test: Verifies WARNING binding rule: gate must NOT switch to NO_GO on warning-only findings
scenarios.purpose: Verifies METADATA_DRIFT detection AND warning-does-not-block constraint

scenarios.name: Search Index Drift

state.search_index: contains chunk_ids not in document_chunks (Phantom chunks)
state.document_chunks: contains chunk_ids without search index entry (Missing chunks)

scenarios.purpose: Verifies SEARCH_INDEX_DRIFT detection including Phantom-chunk critical escalation
